label: diffuse: late original-phase positions (t>=7) and early copy steps, biased to inputs k/f/j/h
explanation: Diffuse unit active on ~5% of steps. Firing rate rises sharply with position in the original phase (orig_idx 7: 28%, orig_idx 8: 51%) so long sequences (L=8-9) dominate, and there is a secondary bump on early copy steps (recall_idx 2-3, ~9%). Never fires at t=0 and rarely at the delimiter. Rate is token-modulated (inputs k, f, j, h about 2.5-3x lift) but no token or position set captures it: the best simple predicate, late original-phase steps (t>=7), gets dev F1 ~0.31 and covers 46% of the top activation quartile vs 17% of the lowest. Unions with token sets and copy-phase clauses reach mass recall ~0.70 only at precision ~0.2. Activations are also spread over many mid-original and copy steps that no tested predicate picks out.
